title: Understanding Contextual Bias in Agricultural CNNs Through Hidden-Neuron Concept Induction
abstract: arXiv:2611.18530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) can classify images using background-dominated patches that contain little or none of the target object, showing that they exploit contextual information. Previous studies detected this behavior through classification accuracy but say little about what CNN hidden layers represent. We investigate whether Concept Induction can reveal interpretable visual properties associated with hidden-neuron activations on contextual image patches. Using five agricultural datasets with high, moderate, and low contextual bias, we analyze four CNN architectures at three network depths and five patch locations. Quantitative image descriptors of each patch are encoded in a knowledge graph and used as background knowledge for Concept Induction, which derives logical expressions characterizing neuron activation. These expressions are tested on held-out images using the Mann-Whitney U test and Cliff's delta. Of 48,013 tes

translated_title: 通过隐藏神经元概念归纳理解农业卷积神经网络（CNN）中的上下文偏差
translated_abstract: 卷积神经网络（CNN）能够利用主要包含背景、几乎不含或完全不含目标对象的图像块对图像进行分类，这表明它们利用了上下文信息。以往的研究通过分类准确率来检测这种行为，但对CNN隐藏层所表示的内容却知之甚少。我们研究概念归纳是否能揭示与上下文图像块上隐藏神经元激活相关的可解释视觉属性。我们使用五个具有高、中、低上下文偏差的农业数据集，分析了四种CNN架构在三个网络深度和五个图像块位置上的表现。每个图像块的定量图像描述符被编码到知识图谱中，并作为概念归纳的背景知识，由此推导出表征神经元激活的逻辑表达式。这些表达式在留出图像上使用Mann-Whitney U检验和Cliff's delta进行验证。在48,013个测试（摘要原文截断）……
tldr: 该论文创新性地将概念归纳方法应用于CNN可解释性研究，通过知识图谱编码图像描述符并推导逻辑表达式，揭示了农业CNN隐藏神经元在上下文图像块上激活所对应的可解释视觉属性，从而深入理解CNN利用背景信息的上下文偏差机制。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers the application of Concept Induction to CNN interpretability, deriving logical expressions from knowledge-graph-encoded image descriptors to reveal interpretable visual properties behind hidden-neuron activations on contextual patches, thereby illuminating how agricultural CNNs exploit background-dominated contextual bias.
